theme: 个股·财务三表交叉：万华化学2025年报利润表/资产负债表/现金流量表交叉验证，净现比纵向与横向对比

initial.question: 万华化学2025年年报的营业总收入是多少？
initial.gold_sql: SELECT P110100 FROM VIEW_STK_INCOME_GEN WHERE A_STOCKCODE='600309' AND ENDDATE='2025-12-31' AND RPT_TYPE='合并' AND RPT_SRC='年报' AND ISVALID=1 AND RPT_DATE=ENDDATE

feedbacks.question: 那它2025年末的资产负债率大概有多高？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(B200000/B100000*100,2) FROM VIEW_STK_BALA_GEN WHERE A_STOCKCODE='600309' AND ENDDATE='2025-12-31' AND RPT_TYPE='合并' AND RPT_SRC='年报' AND ISVALID=1 AND RPT_DATE=ENDDATE

feedbacks.question: 把利润表和现金流量表放在一起看，它2025年经营活动产生的现金流量净额是净利润的几倍？
feedbacks.gold_display: 2.36倍（经营现金流净额约331.05亿元，净利润约140.40亿元）
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(c.C100000/i.P150101,2) FROM VIEW_STK_CASH_GEN c JOIN VIEW_STK_INCOME_GEN i ON i.A_STOCKCODE=c.A_STOCKCODE AND i.ENDDATE=c.ENDDATE AND i.RPT_TYPE=c.RPT_TYPE AND i.RPT_SRC=c.RPT_SRC AND i.RPT_DATE=c.RPT_DATE WHERE c.A_STOCKCODE='600309' AND c.ENDDATE='2025-12-31' AND c.RPT_TYPE='合并' AND c.RPT_SRC='年报' AND c.ISVALID=1 AND i.ISVALID=1

feedbacks.question: 那换成2024年年报，这个倍数是多少？
feedbacks.gold_display: 2.03倍（经营现金流净额约300.53亿元，净利润约147.91亿元）
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(c.C100000/i.P150101,2) FROM VIEW_STK_CASH_GEN c JOIN VIEW_STK_INCOME_GEN i ON i.A_STOCKCODE=c.A_STOCKCODE AND i.ENDDATE=c.ENDDATE AND i.RPT_TYPE=c.RPT_TYPE AND i.RPT_SRC=c.RPT_SRC AND i.RPT_DATE=c.RPT_DATE WHERE c.A_STOCKCODE='600309' AND c.ENDDATE='2024-12-31' AND c.RPT_TYPE='合并' AND c.RPT_SRC='年报' AND c.ISVALID=1 AND i.ISVALID=1

feedbacks.question: 再加一家海尔智家做参照，同样按2025年年报算净现比，两家谁更高？
feedbacks.gold_display: 万华化学2.36倍 > 海尔智家1.29倍，万华化学更高
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT t.A_STOCKSNAME, ROUND(t.ocf/t.np,2) AS nocf_np_ratio FROM (SELECT c.A_STOCKSNAME, c.C100000 AS ocf, i.P150101 AS np FROM VIEW_STK_CASH_GEN c JOIN VIEW_STK_INCOME_GEN i ON i.A_STOCKCODE=c.A_STOCKCODE AND i.ENDDATE=c.ENDDATE AND i.RPT_TYPE=c.RPT_TYPE AND i.RPT_SRC=c.RPT_SRC AND i.RPT_DATE=c.RPT_DATE WHERE c.A_STOCKCODE IN ('600309','600690') AND c.ENDDATE='2025-12-31' AND c.RPT_TYPE='合并' AND c.RPT_SRC='年报' AND c.ISVALID=1 AND i.ISVALID=1) t ORDER BY nocf_np_ratio DESC

feedbacks.question: 换个标的，帮我查一下隆基绿能2025年年报经营活动产生的现金流量净额是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT C100000 FROM VIEW_STK_CASH_GEN WHERE A_STOCKCODE='601012' AND ENDDATE='2025-12-31' AND RPT_TYPE='合并' AND RPT_SRC='年报' AND ISVALID=1 AND RPT_DATE=ENDDATE
